summary: The customer was charged twice for their monthly subscription and wants it resolved.
formal: Dear Customer, we have reviewed your account and see that two identical $39.99 charges were applied for the same subscription period. This is a billing error. We will confirm both transaction IDs in our admin panel and issue a full refund for the duplicate charge. The refund will be processed within a few business days and does not count against the $100 agent approval limit. Please let us know if you have any further questions.
empathetic: Hi there, I’m really sorry you were double‑charged for your Nebula subscription – that must be frustrating. I’ve checked your account and see the duplicate $39.99 charge. It’s a billing error, and I’ll go ahead and refund the extra amount right away. You should see the refund in your account within a few days. If there’s anything else I can help with, just let me know!
short: We’ve identified the duplicate $39.99 charge as a billing error and will refund the extra amount. Refund will be processed shortly.

summary: Customer was charged $59.99 for an annual plan after forgetting to cancel the trial and requests a refund.
formal:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting Nebula Support. I understand that you were charged $59.99 for an annual plan after the trial period ended. Because the charge occurred less than 7 days ago and the app has not been used since the charge, you are eligible for a refund under our policy. I can approve a refund of the full amount, which is within the $100 limit that agents can process without escalation.

I will initiate the refund immediately and you should see the credit on your original payment method within 5‑7 business days. If you have any further questions, please let us know.

Best regards,
Nebula Support Team
empathetic:
Hi there,

I’m really sorry you were charged for the annual plan after forgetting to cancel the trial – that’s frustrating. Since the charge was made just yesterday and you haven’t used the app since, you qualify for a refund. I can approve the $59.99 refund right away (our agents can handle refunds up to $100 without needing extra approval).

The refund will be processed today and should appear on your card within a few days. Let me know if there’s anything else I can do for you!

Take care,
Your Nebula Support Friend
short: We can refund the $59.99 charge – it’s within the 7‑day window and under the $100 limit agents can approve. Refund is being processed now.

summary: The customer cannot log in because the magic link email never arrives despite multiple attempts.
formal: Dear Customer, I’m sorry you’re experiencing difficulty receiving the magic‑link email. Please verify that the email has not been filtered into your spam or promotions folder, as our guidance states: "Check spam and promotions folders. Links expire after 15 minutes and only the latest link works. Corporate mail filters sometimes block the email." If you still do not receive a new link after requesting another, please provide your device model, OS version and app version so we can escalate to Tech support as recommended: "If the customer still cannot sign in after these steps, escalate to Tech support with the device model, OS version and app version."
empathetic: I understand how frustrating it is not to receive the magic‑link email. First, please check your spam or promotions folder – corporate mail filters can sometimes block it. Remember the link only works for 15 minutes and the most recent link is the only valid one. If after trying again you still don’t see it, let us know your device model, OS version and app version so we can involve Tech support.
short: Please check your spam/promotions folder; the link expires in 15 minutes and only the latest works. If you still don’t receive it, reply with your device and app version so we can escalate.

human_reasons: Personal-data request (GDPR): only the Privacy team can action it.; Legal or privacy matter: route to Legal & Privacy, agent must not commit to anything.
summary: The customer requests that their account and all personal data be deleted in accordance with GDPR.
formal: Thank you for contacting Nebula. Your request to delete your account and all personal data has been forwarded to our Privacy team, which will complete the deletion within 30 days as required by GDPR. You may also delete the account yourself via Profile → Settings → Delete account if you prefer. Please note that account deletion does not cancel any App Store or Google Play subscriptions; those must be cancelled directly in the store.
empathetic: I’m sorry you need to leave us, and I understand how important it is to have your data removed. I’ve forwarded your deletion request to our Privacy team, and they will handle it within the 30‑day GDPR window. If you’d rather delete the account yourself, you can do so in Profile → Settings → Delete account. Also, remember that any App Store or Google Play subscriptions remain active until you cancel them in the store.
short: Your deletion request has been sent to our Privacy team and will be completed within 30 days per GDPR. Account deletion does not cancel App Store/Google Play subscriptions; you must cancel those separately.

If you feel you are in immediate danger, please call 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or your local emergency services right away. You are not alone, and help is available.
empathetic: I’m really sorry you’re feeling this way. It sounds incredibly painful, and I want you to know we care about you. I’ve flagged this to our Trust & Safety team right away, and I encourage you to reach out to the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (or your local emergency services) right now. You deserve support and there are people ready to help.
short: We’re very concerned. We’ve escalated this to Trust & Safety and recommend calling 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or local emergency services immediately.

summary: The customer was charged twice for a subscription and asks for the extra charge to be returned.
formal: Шановний(а) клієнте, дякуємо за повідомлення. Ми виявили два однакових списання за підписку за один період, що відповідає випадку реального дублювання. Підтвердимо обидва ідентифікатори транзакцій у адмін‑панелі та здійснимо повне повернення зайвого списання. Таке повернення не підлягає ліміту в $100. Очікуйте зарахування коштів протягом 5‑7 робочих днів.

Ми швидко підтвердимо транзакції і повернемо зайвий платіж у повному розмірі. Повернення не враховується у ліміті $100, і гроші будуть повернені протягом кількох днів.

summary: The customer entered the wrong birth date during registration and wants to change it in their profile.
formal:
Estimado/a cliente,

Para corregir la fecha de nacimiento en su perfil, abra la sección Perfil, diríjase a Datos personales y edite la fecha, hora o lugar de nacimiento. El mapa natal y los horóscopos se volverán a calcular en pocos minutos.

Tenga en cuenta que la información de nacimiento puede modificarse hasta 3 veces al mes, según nuestra política para evitar el abuso de lecturas gratuitas.

Quedamos a su disposición para cualquier otra consulta.
empathetic:
¡Hola! Lamento que la fecha de nacimiento se haya ingresado incorrectamente. Para solucionarlo, solo tiene que entrar en Perfil → Datos personales y actualizar la fecha, hora o lugar de nacimiento; el horóscopo se actualizará en unos minutos.

Recuerde que puede hacer este cambio hasta 3 veces al mes.

Si necesita ayuda adicional, avísenos y con gusto le asistimos.
short: Abra Perfil → Datos personales, edite la fecha de nacimiento y guarde; el horóscopo se recalcula en minutos. Puede hacerlo hasta 3 veces al mes.

summary: The customer cancelled their subscription but was still charged and feels it is fraud.
formal:
Sehr geehrte*r Kund*in,

vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Wir haben festgestellt, dass Ihnen nach einer bestätigten Kündigung dennoch ein Betrag belastet wurde. Gemäß unserer Richtlinie erstatten wir in solchen Fällen den Betrag und fügen die Kündigungsbestätigung dem Ticket bei. [double-charge] "If the customer was charged after a confirmed cancellation, refund the charge and attach the cancellation confirmation to the ticket." Zudem bleibt Ihr Zugang bis zum Ende des bereits bezahlten Zeitraums aktiv, weitere Verlängerungen werden nicht mehr berechnet. [cancel-web] "Access stays active until the end of the paid period. No further renewals are charged. Cancelling does not refund the current period automatically; see the refund policy." Wir leiten die Rückerstattung umgehend ein und bestätigen Ihnen die vollständige Kündigung. Sollten Sie weitere Fragen haben, stehen wir Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Ihr Nebula‑Supportteam
empathetic:
Hallo,

es tut mir sehr leid, dass Sie trotz Ihrer Kündigung erneut belastet wurden – das ist natürlich ärgerlich. Wir kümmern uns sofort darum, den fälschlich abgebuchten Betrag zurückzuerstatten und legen die Kündigungsbestätigung Ihrem Ticket bei, wie es unsere Richtlinie vorsieht. [double-charge] "If the customer was charged after a confirmed cancellation, refund the charge and attach the cancellation confirmation to the ticket." Ihr Zugang bleibt bis zum Ende des bereits bezahlten Zeitraums aktiv, und es werden keine weiteren Gebühren anfallen. [cancel-web] "Access stays active until the end of the paid period. No further renewals are charged. Cancelling does not refund the current period automatically; see the refund policy." Wir melden uns, sobald die Rückerstattung veranlasst ist. Danke für Ihr Verständnis.

Beste Grüße,
Ihr Nebula‑Team
short: Wir erstatten den nach Ihrer Kündigung abgebuchten Betrag und fügen die Kündigungsbestätigung bei. Der Zugang bleibt bis zum Ende der bezahlten Periode aktiv, weitere Gebühren fallen nicht an. [double-charge][cancel-web]

summary: The user reports that the natal chart page shows only a white screen and does not load.
formal: Шановний користувачу, будь ласка, оновіть додаток до останньої версії, перезапустіть телефон і переконайтеся, що на пристрої залишилося щонайменше 1 ГБ вільного сховища. Якщо білий екран з’являється лише при відкритті натальної карти, спробуйте очистити кеш (Android) або перевстановити додаток (iOS). Якщо проблема не зникає, надайте модель пристрою, версію ОС, версію додатку та кроки відтворення, щоб ми могли передати інцидент до технічної підтримки.

Потім очистіть кеш (Android) або перевстановіть додаток (iOS). Якщо й далі бачите білий екран, будь ласка, повідомте нам модель телефону, версію ОС і додатку, щоб ми могли швидко передати проблему технічній команді.
short: Оновіть додаток, перезапустіть телефон, звільніть ≥1 ГБ, очистіть кеш (Android) або перевстановіть (iOS). Якщо не допоможе – надайте модель, OS і версію додатку для ескалації.
